chunks: A number from our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Al-Nu'man, from Ibrahim ibn Sinan, from Abu Maryam who said:

I was with Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) circumambulating, and it was such that he did not pass by the Yamani corner during his circumambulation except that he touched it, then he was saying: 'O Allah! Turn towards me (with Mercy) until I repent, and Protect me until I do not repeat'.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) say when touching the Yamani corner during Tawaf?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Yamani corner (al-Rukn al-Yamani) as a specific locus for seeking *Tawbah* (repentance) and *Istiqamah* (steadfastness), reflecting the Shia emphasis on the spiritual efficacy of physical acts of worship. The Imam’s supplication underscores the transition from mere ritual performance to internal spiritual purification, a theme central to the teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding the inner dimensions of Hajj and Umrah.
